result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a broken-looking element in the bottom navigation bar and partial cutoff of a horizontal restaurant card.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar contains an unexplained horizontal line/rectangle positioned between the search and bookmark icons, which looks like a misplaced active-indicator or visual artifact.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar; if it is meant to indicate the active tab, align it beneath the corresponding icon and use a consistent style.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol') is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add padding or a peek state to the horizontal scroll container so users can clearly see there are more items to swipe through.
